reviewNotes: Reviewed all 32 cards and every speech key against data/pages80-about-fish.json vocabulary/furigana. Resolved residual kanji and duplicated cooking-name readings. Corrected 活け締め/神経締め/昆布締め to いけじめ/しんけいじめ/こんぶじめ, 即殺 to そくさつ, 丸魚/白身魚 to まるざかな/しろみざかな, 甘辛い to あまからい, miso 床 to とこ, 品がある to ひんがある, 苦香ばしさ to にがこうばしさ, contextual 何が to なにが, and 塩辛い to しおからい. Checked contextual topic は, directional へ and object を; preserved lexical はんだん, はり, はらみ, はいり, はいいろ, はいしゅつ, はやく, はさみ, へこんだ and へんしょく. Retained loanword long vowels. Questions, explanations and extended sentence answers use Nova generation speed 1.0; vocabulary and very short phrase/group inputs use 0.85. Display labels and distinct lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
